name: Ninja vs Pirates: Quest to Save the Dragon
author: hoshpup
description:
The Robo-Pirates have captured one of the elemental fire dragons! As one of the Ninja, embark on a platforming adventure to save the dragon!

This microgame has 3 levels to venture through. Each with a different objective and enemies! (Did someone say laser sharks?)


Controls
WASD or use the Arrow Keys to move. Space to jump.
Dragon specific: Space to breathe fire, left click to fly up right click to fly down.

Had a lot of fun making the levels and builds, had to tone down the enemies as it used to be too difficult, hope you enjoy!
